q: The Holevo bound χ(ρ,{pᵢ,ρᵢ}) limits the classical information accessible from an ensemble {pᵢ,ρᵢ} of quantum states via any measurement. It states the accessible information is at most:
opts: S(Σᵢ pᵢρᵢ) − Σᵢ pᵢ S(ρᵢ) = χ (the Holevo quantity)
exp: Holevo bound: I(X;Y) ≤ χ = S(ρ) − Σ pᵢS(ρᵢ) where ρ = Σpᵢρᵢ. The accessible information from measuring an ensemble cannot exceed χ. Equality is achievable (HSW theorem) with product-state encoding and suitable measurements.
